turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, good to have you here. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My son is turning seven and we're choosing where to have his party.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me lay out all the options first. Don't interrupt.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The first option is the trampoline park, which the kids love, but it's pretty expensive per child.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's having it at home with a bouncy castle in the backyard.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Option three is a picnic at the park with games and a big cake.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last one is a pizza making class at a local restaurant.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's everything. Which one would you pick?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The trampoline park is a guaranteed hit with seven year olds, but the cost adds up fast with a big guest list. A bouncy castle at home gets a lot of the same fun for less. The pizza class is a fun idea, especially for kids who like to make things.
